title: npm repository settings
description: The npm member of a repository document. A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable.

latestGuard.title: Guard the latest tag
latestGuard.description: A publish under latest does not move latest backwards or onto a pre-release in front of a release; the version is stored and latest stays.

serveRemovedVersions.title: Serve removed versions
serveRemovedVersions.description: Serve the cached tarball of a version the upstream no longer lists, and keep its package served when the upstream drops it. The package documents never list such a version.

latestStrategy.title: Latest tag strategy
latestStrategy.description: How a virtual repository merges latest.

distTagStrategy.title: Dist-tag strategy
distTagStrategy.description: How a virtual repository merges the other dist-tags.

audit.title: Security audit
audit.description: The security audit endpoint: answer from trove's own advisory data, or forward the names this remote has fetched, and that nothing marks internal, to an advisory provider.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: local answers from trove's own advisory data and sends nothing out (every class; 503 vulnerability_data_unavailable until the npm data is complete; answers like disabled while vulnerabilities.enabled is false). forward answers through the first remote that forwards (remote and virtual repositories; a local repository answers like disabled). disabled answers 501 npm_audit_unavailable. Left out, the audit answers from trove's data while vulnerabilities.enabled is true and the OSV source is not off; else the mode is forward on remote and virtual repositories and disabled on local ones.

providerURL.title: Provider URL
providerURL.description: Mode forward only. The https registry URL of the advisory provider, without user info, query or fragment; null is the remote's upstream URL. The provider gets the repository's sealed upstream credentials only when it is the upstream's origin or an extraHosts entry with sendCredentials, never through the URL.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Mode forward only. The longest a forward may take, 1s to 300s; never longer than server.shutdown_timeout minus one second.

maxBodySize.title: Largest body
maxBodySize.description: The largest audit body as sent, 1KiB to 10MiB; ten times that decompressed. Larger bodies answer 413.
